component.name: Xylitol
component.summary: Find, download and install Android packages

description.p: Xylitol searches APKPure, shows every file a release ships — one per architecture, sometimes per screen density, sometimes a bundle beside a plain APK — and lets you choose which to download rather than guessing for you.

Downloads resume where they stopped and are checked against the checksum APKPure publishes. Xylitol reads the package itself, so it can show the real package name, version, architectures and requested permissions before anything is installed.
Installing is handed to an Android runtime already on the system: Waydroid, or any device reachable over adb.
First release: APKPure search, per-architecture file selection, resumable verified downloads, package inspection, and installation through Waydroid or adb.
